text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was fired up to gain 
overwhelming strength during this summer 
training camp—enough to overcome any jinx.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Kitasan Black is bursting with 
motivation too. The two fire each other up 
to do their best toward the day they can 
run together.
